claim: Head Coach Position scoring : r/fantasyfootball - Reddit
summary: This year, my league is proposing to add ESPN's Head Coach position. The currently proposed scoring breakdown would be: +2 for win, -2 for loss, -1 for tie (because no HC worth his salt goes for a tie) and then +1/-1 for each 5 points of margin. So a 24-point blowout victory would score you 6 points, while a 27-24 loss would be -2. Thoughts on the scoring breakdown? Does anyone have experience ...
